checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish exhibits a single dorsal fin located far back on the body, near the tail. This is a defining characteristic of the Pike family, whereas the barracouta has two separated dorsal fins.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anal fin similar to second dorsal.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Due to the angle and the species mismatch (Pike anatomy), the anal fin does not match the description of being similar to a non-existent second dorsal fin. It is positioned opposite the single rear dorsal fin.
